messages:
maria: quick Q — should service API keys be project-scoped by default or allow org-scoped keys for cross-project infra jobs?
alex: project-scoped by default. org-scoped is too broad for regular automation.
kevin: agree on default, but we have legacy org keys used by infra. need a safe migration path.
jess: also add an origin_service claim so downstream can make policy decisions.
maria: origin_service claim is good. operator/admin flows still need a single org key sometimes — how do we make that safe?
alex: require explicit operator=true claim + MFA/approval + audit entry for org keys.
kevin: runtime question: if an org-scoped key targets a project resource, do we allow it? how do we record the effective project?
jess: proposal: allow org->project only if key has can_impersonate_projects list including target OR request supplies X-Target-Project header and ACL permits. otherwise deny.
maria: and log both original key id and effective project id plus reason for decision. makes audits traceable.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: note: adding per-key claims likely needs a DB migration to store claim metadata. run migration-checker.
kevin: short-term add a JSON claims column. long-term normalize. add tests around evaluation order.
jess: agreed. explicit tests for precedence: token.project > key-derived-project > org-fallback.
alex: example token snippet for RFC draft: { "kid": "k-xyz-001", "iss": "key-service", "origin_service": "svc-ingest", "project": "proj-analytics", "can_impersonate_projects": ["proj-ops"], "operator": false, "legacy": false }
maria: migration plan sketch: 1) add claims column + logging fields, 2) emit telemetry metrics (auth.effective_project, auth.key_origin) + dashboard, 3) roll out warn-only mode for 30 days, 4) enable enforcement by default.
kevin: for legacy keys add legacy:true and require non-empty migration_justification to keep org behavior.
jess: console UX: warn strongly when creating org-wide keys and require an explicit ACK. store that ack for audit.
maria: also default new operator tokens to ephemeral (TTL <=1h). reduces blast radius.
alex: I'll draft the RFC with steps, example payloads, and SDK guidance. want pairing on migration tests tomorrow?
kevin: I can pair.
jess: me too.
maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
